## Editorial & Structure Checklist

- [ ] **Clear Hook & Definition:** Introduces the core concept, defines key technical terms, and states the real-world problem in the first two paragraphs.
- [ ] **Actionable Structure:** Uses logical `##` / `###` headings, concise paragraphs, and step-by-step execution rather than abstract walls of text.
- [ ] **Platform Formatting:**
  - *DEV.to:* Includes valid Liquid tags (`{% tag %}`) and frontmatter (`title`, `published`, `description`, `tags`, `canonical_url`) if applicable.
  - *SitePoint:* Adheres to editorial style guidelines (sentence case headings, concise intros, and clear takeaways).
- [ ] **Verification Steps Included:** Every major setup or configuration step includes a concrete verification cue (expected terminal output, HTTP status, or UI state).

---

## Code Samples & Technical Accuracy

- [ ] **Tested End-to-End:** All commands, configuration snippets, and scripts in `/samples/` have been executed cleanly in a fresh environment.
- [ ] **Syntax & Language Identifiers:** Every fenced code block specifies its exact language (`python`, `bash`, `yaml`, `json`, etc.).
- [ ] **No Hardcoded Secrets:** API keys, tokens, passwords, and private IPs are replaced with environment variables or placeholders (e.g., `YOUR_API_KEY`).
- [ ] **Edge Cases & Error Handling:** Retries, timeouts, or failure states are explicitly addressed in production-oriented snippets.

---

## Links, Media & Cross-References

- [ ] **Working External Links:** All official documentation links resolve with `200 OK` and point to current versions.
- [ ] **Complementary Internal Links:** Links out to relevant companion repositories, live demos, or foundational articles without broken relative paths.
- [ ] **Images & Diagrams:** All screenshots or architecture diagrams use descriptive `alt` text, are compressed for fast loading, and have no sensitive data visible.
